# S601 — Decisions detail: pgdown and pgup skip content at heights 10, 16 and 24 (scrollDecision marker budget)

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-27** — Also covers S602 (questions detail, shared scrollDecision marker budget), S603 (waves item pane, waveItemKey marker budget, heights 10-40) and S604 (settings pane, settingsKey marker and pinned heading budget). Apply S579's page-step fix (page by room minus the lines the draw spends on markers) to all four panes and re-enable their TestScrollSweep cases. Jon chose 'One slice', session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:** Questions detail, Waves, Settings, sweep helper changes.

## Why

S588's `TestScrollSweep` found four panes whose page keys skip content at some heights. Decisions detail and Questions detail share `scrollDecision`, and both fail at heights 10, 16 and 24. The Waves item pane (`waveItemKey`) fails at 10, 16, 24 and 40. The Settings pane (`settingsKey`) fails at 10, 16 and 24. Each pane draws a "+N more lines" marker in one line of its window, and the Settings pane also pins a block heading under its "+N lines above" marker. Each page key moves by the whole window height, so the line under the marker never appears. S588 left these cases out under adj 575. An example of a missing line is `2026-10-24 decision event number 08`.

The owner chose S579's page step for all four panes, in one slice (Jon, session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27, S601 note). A page key moves by the pane's window less the lines the draw spends on markers. S579 landed this for the Roadmap item pane in `scrollItemPane` and `scrollRoadmapPane` (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:103-173`). This slice applies the same step to the other three, and puts their sweep cases back at heights 10, 16, 24 and 40. S602, S603 and S604 are merged into S601.

- TestScrollSweep/decisions-detail at heights 10, 16 and 24 (the case's heights widen from `{40}` to `sweepAll`; `pgdown` and `pgup`): paging to the end and back must show every line of the detail. It fails now with "never showed" lines in both passes, for example `2026-10-24 decision event number 08`.
- TestScrollSweep/questions-detail at heights 10, 16 and 24 (heights widen from `{40}` to `sweepAll`): the same assertion for the Questions detail pane. It fails now for the same reason, because it shares `scrollDecision`.
- TestScrollSweep/waves-item at heights 10, 16, 24 and 40 (new case using `sweepWavesItem`, `pgdown` and `pgup`): paging must show every line, including `body of wave section 015`. It fails now at every height.
- TestScrollSweep/settings at heights 10, 16 and 24 (heights widen from `{40}` to `sweepAll`): paging must show every row, including `worktree_pattern     unset`. It fails now because the page step ignores the marker lines and the pinned block heading.
- TestDecisionsFixScrollIsTopLineAndClamped (changed): `pgdown` from the top of a long record must leave `decisionScroll` at the window height less the marker line, 24 where it asserts 25 today, and `pgup` must return it to 0. It fails against the fixed code until the expectation changes.
- TestWavesItemPanePageKeysUseVisibleHeight (changed): `pgdown` from the top must leave `paneOffset` at `size[1]-7` (the old `size[1]-6` less the marker line) at 100x30 and 80x24. The later `down` then `pgup` must still end at offset 1. It fails against the fixed code until the first expectation changes.

## Implement

1. In `internal/tui/decisions.go`, change the page case of `scrollDecision`. Today `delta *= visible`. Set the step to `visible-1` when `visible >= 3` (the window draws a "+N more lines" marker from 3 lines up) and to `visible` below that. Use it as the multiplier. The draw in `decisions` and `questions` slices the detail from the offset, so only the "more lines" marker takes a line, and the last page still ends flush through the `last` clamp. Leave `scrollHalf`, which calls `scrollDecision(step, false)`, as it is.
2. In `internal/tui/waves.go`, change `step` in the `pgdown` and `pgup` case of `waveItemKey` from `max(height-4-headerLines, 1)` to `max(height-5-headerLines, 1)`. `waveItemBody` windows the body from the offset after the heading, so the "more lines" marker is the only line lost. The heading is at least 1 line, so the `max` keeps the step at 1 when the window is under 3 lines.
3. In `internal/tui/settings.go`, add two fields to `settingsState` next to `room`: `pageDown` and `pageUp`. They are the offset steps of the page keys, taken from the last draw.
4. In `settingsBody`, after the offset is final, define `reach(start)`. It is the first body line the window at `start` leaves out, with the same shape the draw uses:
   - When `canPin && start > 0 && start < len(heads) && heads[start] != ""`, it is `hi` from `span(len(lines), start, room-1)`.
   - Otherwise it is `hi` from `span(len(lines), start, room)`.
5. Set `s.pageDown = max(reach(s.offset)-s.offset, 1)`. Set `s.pageUp` to `s.offset-back`, where `back` is the smallest start in `[0, s.offset)` with `reach(back) >= s.offset`. When `s.offset` is 0, set it to 1.
6. In `settingsKey`, make `PageDown` add `max(s.pageDown, 1)` and `PageUp` subtract `max(s.pageUp, 1)`, replacing `s.room`. Keep the existing clamps in `settingsBody`. A window that starts mid-block still pins its heading, so no line is skipped.
7. In `internal/tui/scroll_sweep_test.go`:
   - Change the `decisions-detail`, `questions-detail` and `settings` cases from `heights: []int{40}` to `heights: sweepAll`, and keep `unique: true`.
   - Add `{name: "waves-item", heights: sweepAll, unique: true, setup: sweepWavesItem, pageDown: sweepPgDown, pageUp: sweepPgUp}` after the `questions-detail` case.
   - Remove the four "Left out" bullets (S601 to S604) from the comment above `TestScrollSweep`, and the comment's lines about height 40 and the fixtures.
   - Leave the sweep helpers, the fixtures and `TestSweepPaneFixturesScroll` unchanged.
8. In `internal/tui/decisions_test.go` and `internal/tui/waves_test.go`, change the `pgdown` expectations to 24 and `size[1]-7`, and fix the comments beside them.
9. In `docs/dashboard.md:576-581`, widen the page-step sentence to the decision, Roadmap item, matrix, spec-draft and Waves item panes. In the Settings paragraph at `2496-2504`, add that `pgdown` starts the next page at the first line the window left out and `pgup` at the first window that reaches the current top. Keep it short and ASCII.
10. Run the checks below. No golden view is expected to change; review any diff before `-update`.
